decisions.decision: Separate underlying XRP custody, cbXRP issuance, cbXRP collateral posted, USDC supplied, USDC borrowed and USDC lender/vault source.
decisions.reason: A wrapped XRP collateral position is not a new XRP spot purchase; a USDC loan is credit, not new net capital.

decisions.decision: Store Morpho utilization separately from collateral LTV and liquidation threshold.
decisions.reason: 89.8% utilization is borrowed/supplied USDC; 62.5% LLTV is collateral/debt liquidation boundary; 49% is Coinbase UI maximum initial LTV.

decisions.decision: Keep market attribution to Coinbase as a strong inference unless Coinbase publishes a market ID or borrower-origin mapping.
decisions.reason: Morpho is permissionless and the same market can be used by borrowers outside Coinbase's interface.

decisions.decision: Model collateral lock and liquidation risk separately from spot-demand features.
decisions.reason: 118.59M cbXRP is posted as collateral; liquidations can release or sell collateral during stress, but minting cbXRP wraps existing XRP.

decisions.decision: Record vault concentration and utilization as liquidity-risk features, not as Circle capital deployment.
decisions.reason: Nine vaults supply $58.19M; Circle is the USDC issuer but no direct Circle lending allocation is established.

no_inference_rules: Do not call collateral posted a spot purchase.
Do not call USDC borrowed new capital or Circle direct lending.
Do not equate utilization with borrower LTV.
Do not attribute all permissionless market borrowers to Coinbase retail customers.
